divider.description: before or after: a thin bar on that side of the chip, between it and its neighbour in the pod. Empty for none.
divider.label: Divider

dropdown.description: Click opens the tooltip in colour, and the chip's on-click moves to its Open button. Off for a chip whose click acts (cycles the mic, starts a stream).
dropdown.label: Click opens the dropdown

module.description: The waybar module id in config.base, such as custom/ci
module.label: Waybar module
